en_title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance Developer Hit by 'Serious' Cybersecurity Incident
cn_title: 《天国：拯救》开发商称遭严重网攻
subtitle: 系统与数据遭入侵
opus_summary: 《天国：拯救》开发商称遭遇严重网络攻击，系统与数据遭入侵。工作室正联合专家保护系统、调查并评估影响，也已联系有关部门追查攻击者，具体影响范围尚不明确。

paragraphs.en: Warhorse Studios — the developer behind Kingdom Come: Deliverance, its sequel, and an upcoming Lord of the Rings RPG — has been hit by a “serious” cyberattack. The company announced the news on its website .
paragraphs.cn: 《天国：拯救》及其续作的开发商Warhorse Studios在官网宣布，工作室遭遇了「严重」网络攻击。该工作室还在开发一款尚未推出的《指环王》RPG。

paragraphs.en: The developer is currently working with cybersecurity experts to “secure its systems, investigate the incident, and assess its full impact.” Warhorse has also reached out to authorities to track down the culprits, who accessed company systems and data.
paragraphs.cn: 工作室目前正与网络安全专家合作，「保护系统安全、调查事件并全面评估影响」。攻击者侵入了公司的系统并访问了数据，Warhorse也已联系有关部门追查肇事者。

paragraphs.en: “This is a serious incident for Warhorse Studios and everyone affected,” said Martin Frývaldský, CEO of Warhorse Studios. “Our immediate priority is to secure our systems, establish the full extent of the breach, and take the necessary steps to protect our employees, partners, and community.
paragraphs.cn: Warhorse Studios首席执行官Martin Frývaldský表示：「对Warhorse Studios和所有受影响的人来说，这是一起严重事件。我们的当务之急是保护系统安全，查清此次入侵的完整范围，并采取必要措施，保护我们的员工、合作伙伴和社区。

paragraphs.en: “We are dedicating the resources needed to address this situation and will communicate further information as soon as we responsibly can.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们正在投入所需资源来应对这一情况，并会在能够负责任地披露信息的前提下，尽快公布更多消息。」

paragraphs.en: Warhorse said it won’t comment further or conduct any interviews on the topic, so the extent of the attack isn’t clear at the moment. The studio will share updates as it can.
paragraphs.cn: Warhorse表示，不会就此事进一步置评或接受采访，因此目前尚不清楚这次攻击的影响范围。工作室会在条件允许时公布最新进展。

paragraphs.en: Warhorse Studios is currently working on a Lord of the Rings role-playing game, described as an “open world Middle-earth RPG,” and a new Kingdom Come game expected to be Kingdom Come: Deliverance 3 or a spinoff.
paragraphs.cn: Warhorse Studios目前正在开发一款《指环王》角色扮演游戏，官方将其描述为「以中土世界为背景的开放世界RPG」。工作室还在开发一款《天国》系列新作，预计会是《天国：拯救3》或一款衍生作品。

paragraphs.en: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 launched last year to critical and commercial acclaim. IGN's Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 review returned a 9/10. We said: "Armed with excellent melee combat and an exceptional story, Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 is one part sequel and one part coronation, bringing a lot of the original's ideas to fruition."
paragraphs.cn: 《天国：拯救2》于去年发售，口碑与商业表现双双告捷。IGN在评测中给出了9分（满分10分），并评价道：「凭借出色的近战战斗和非凡的故事，《天国：拯救2》既是一部续作，也是一场加冕，让初代的许多构想得以实现。」

paragraphs.en: While Warhorse has enjoyed significant success with Kingdom Come: Deliverance, it has come under fire recently for its use of generatve AI . Daniel Vávra, the previous director of Kingdom Come: Deliverance, stepped down from his role in February to focus on making a Kingdom Come: Deliverance movie .
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Warhorse凭借《天国：拯救》取得了显著成功，但工作室最近也因使用生成式AI而受到批评。《天国：拯救》前总监Daniel Vávra已于2月卸任，转而专注于制作《天国：拯救》电影。

paragraphs.en: This month, Japanese developer Capcom was also hit with a cyberattack which saw 196 customer accounts compromised. Retailer Playasia was also taken offline . These hacks coincide with what security experts have dubbed “Black October” in which AI agents have disrupted internet security. It isn’t clear if Capcom, Playasai, or the Warhorse hack is related to that.
paragraphs.cn: 本月，日本开发商卡普空也遭遇了网络攻击，196个客户账户遭入侵。零售商Playasia也因攻击而下线。这些攻击恰逢安全专家所称的「黑色十月」，期间AI智能体扰乱了互联网安全。目前尚不清楚卡普空、Playasia或Warhorse遭遇的攻击是否与此有关。
